name: silver-a
prompt: Keep this exact aircraft, the exact same shape, outline, proportions, top-down orthographic view, nose straight up, symmetry, size and position in the frame, and keep the dark cockpit windscreen and the tiny cabin windows. Change only the finish: polished brushed aluminium, a premium satin silver like an Apple MacBook or Apple Watch case, with a very fine directional brushed grain running along the fuselage and along each wing span, soft bright reflections from a large studio softbox at the top left, a crisp specular line along the fuselage spine and the wing leading edges, cool mid-grey shading on the far sides, true metallic volume, clean and pristine. Fully transparent background, no shadow.

name: silver-b
prompt: Same aircraft, same outline, same top-down view, same scale and placement, pixel-faithful geometry. Re-render it in anodised and bead-blasted silver aluminium, like the finish of an Apple product: soft satin sheen, subtle brushed texture, light silver-grey base, gentle brighter highlights where the surfaces face the top-left light, slightly deeper grey on the lower-right edges, dark smoked cockpit glass, tiny dark cabin windows. Clean, minimal, premium. Fully transparent background, no shadow.

name: mach-a
prompt: Use the reference ONLY for its rendering style: glossy white paint, subtle panel shading, faint panel seams, dark cockpit windscreen, studio light from the top left, realistic premium product-render look, strict top-down orthographic view with the nose straight up and perfect left-right symmetry. Create a different aircraft: a realistic modern supersonic business jet. A very long slender fuselage with a long sharp needle nose and a dark narrow cockpit windscreen, a few tiny cabin windows; a thin ogee delta wing set well back on the fuselage, highly swept leading edge blending smoothly into the body, sharp clipped tips; small swept tailplane; two slim engine nacelles side by side at the rear under the wing roots, with round exhaust nozzles at the very back; a slim swept fin seen edge-on as a thin line. Correct real-aircraft proportions, length about twice the span. Centred, filling about 88 percent of the frame height. No flames. Fully transparent background, no shadow.

name: mach-b
prompt: Same studio render style, material and lighting as the reference (glossy white paint, faint panel seams, soft shading, dark cockpit glass, light from the top left, orthographic top-down view, nose straight up, perfectly symmetric). New aircraft: an elegant supersonic jet in the spirit of Concorde and modern supersonic airliner concepts, generic and unbranded: long thin fuselage with a sharp pointed nose, a slender cranked delta wing with a long fillet starting near the cockpit and graceful curved leading edge, wingtips small and straight, two or four slim engine nacelles under the rear wing showing as slim pods at the trailing edge, no horizontal tailplane, a thin fin. Realistic proportions. Centred, filling about 88 percent of the frame height. No flames. Fully transparent background, no shadow.
